thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — Cloud partner asked for a lightweight Terraform overlay for the marketplace ref-arch. Must cover private storage (S3/GCS), KMS integration, and subnet tagging so their deploy pipeline can autodiscover. Can we produce a module + one-page README and a tiny example by end of week? @jeff @sophie :eyes:
jeff: I can take the module. Thinking of a tiny module that exposes inputs: project_id, vpc_id, storage_type (s3|gcs), kms_key, subnet_tags. Keep outputs minimal (storage_bucket_id, iam_role). Example var block:
```hcl
variable "project_id" { type = string }
variable "storage_type" { type = string }
```
Would that cover partner needs?
sophie: Yes, that's fine. Please also add an option for 'enforce_private' bool that toggles bucket/object-level private config + VPC-SC or private endpoints config (doc link). We should include a snippet showing how to pass pre-existing KMS vs create new.
maria: Perfect. Partner asked for a 5-min explainer doc and a template to drop into their CI (GitHub Actions). Can we include a short policy snippet for required IAM perms? e.g., storage.admin on bucket, kms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter.
jeff: Will add IAM snippet and a small GH Actions snippet that runs `terraform init && plan`. I'll put examples under `examples/marketplace-quickstart`.
cloud_partner_bot: Reminder: attach partner NDA tag and track the public artifact as a marketplace 'overlay' — set visibility to private until partner approves.
sophie: One more ask from partner: annotation in README showing which parts are safe to customize vs must remain pinned for marketplace certification (e.g., don't change encryption algorithms). I'll add a small 'compatibility.md' note.
maria: Timeline: module + README draft by Thursday EOD, examples + GH Actions by Friday noon, partner review Friday afternoon. If blockers, ping me. :thumbsup:
jeff: Starting a draft branch now: `partner/overlay/quickpatch` — will push a WIP module tomorrow morning.
sophie: I'll draft the README and compatibility notes today and link to the ref-arch diagrams.
maria: Thanks team — this is a small deliverable but high impact for the partner onboarding flow.
